rationale: RESUBMISSION of 40c563ba (mig 703, max_images 8 -> 16), answering each round-1 objection with fresh first-hand measurements. A census over ALL rows of the type with NO filters at all — SELECT type, version, is_active, COALESCE(is_snapshot,false), deleted_at FROM agent_definitions WHERE type='design-critique-agent' — returns exactly ONE row (v1, active, non-snapshot, non-deleted), so the UPDATE could not have touched a second row and the loader (WHERE type=$1 AND is_active ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1, ai_actions.go:1313) can only read the row 703 wrote. The landmine's own fleet-wide duplicate census re-run the same day returns exactly its four documented types (chief-strategist, content-creator, content-creator-contact, site-component-architect); design-critique-agent is not among them. Its second arm: active snapshots 0, active-but-deleted 0, loader-visible 207. Also correcting a round-1 speculation: the applied file HAS an explicit BEGIN/COMMIT around the UPDATE and the DO/RAISE guard (checksummed in schema_migrations), so the guard ran inside the same transaction — a multi-row state would have aborted the COMMIT, not merely reported late. These are the same checks that won approval for 52c9a201 round 3 (2026-09-02 17:32Z) on the same agent row. (2) llm_reliability [medium], thinking budget: no longer unaddressed — migration 704 (applied+recorded 2026-09-02, snapshot first) raised the critique step's RESOLVED max_tokens 6000 -> 16000 at the key resolveAIServiceConfig actually reads, guarded in the resolver's precedence order, exactly the adaptive-thinking landmine's prescribed remedy; the council APPROVED it under correlation 52c9a201 (round 3). (4) debug_historian [low], no sidecar files: the inline snapshot + DO/RAISE + inverse-jsonb_set-in-comment shape is this agent's approved house pattern — 663 (the exact inverse of this migration) passed round 2 with it on 2026-09-02. Context for the value 16: the audit captures 8 URLs x 2 viewports (today's run metadata: urls_audited 8 of pages_total 40), so 16 restores exactly full capture coverage, and the 663 cap's stated premise (no downscaling anywhere) ended when the downscale shipped and was proven live (approved, e5a664d9).
